steps: Pressure cook the soaked rajma and the potato with water to cover for 6 to 7 whistles on medium, until a bean mashes easily. Drain.
Peel the potato and mash it with the rajma until smooth, with no whole beans left.
Mix in the crumbled bread, most of the cumin (crushed) and the chopped coriander leaves, and shape into small flat tikkis.
Cook the tikkis in the oil on a flat pan on medium-low for 3 to 4 minutes a side, until golden.
For the soup, pressure cook the chopped beetroot and carrot with about 150 ml water a person for 3 to 4 whistles on medium.
Let the pressure drop, then blend the vegetables with their water until smooth; strain it if your child likes it thin.
Warm the soup on low with the last pinch of cumin until it just starts to bubble.
Serve the tikkis with the soup. Cool until just warm before serving.
note: Rajma must be cooked very soft and mashed fully for a toddler; rinsed tinned rajma saves the soak. No salt, chilli or amchur in either part.
